title: Comics Greatest World Pit Bulls Dark Horse 1993 Week 2 Bob McLeod Cover

descriptionText:
Comics' Greatest World: Pit Bulls (Dark Horse Comics, 1993) -- Week 2 of the Comics' Greatest World launch event, introducing the Pit Bulls team from the Steel Harbor arc. Bob McLeod cover art. Back cover carries the Comics' Greatest Contest giveaway ad with Topps. Cover price $1 US.

Condition: Cover clean and glossy with light handling wear. Please review the photos - they are of the actual copy you will receive.
